context.title: Retry interrupted uploads
context.body: Retries interrupted uploads while preserving completed work.

knownIssues.rootCause: The retry path replaces the first upload error instead of retaining both causes.
knownIssues.failureBehavior: Operators lose the error that explains why the first upload attempt failed.
knownIssues.verification: A focused test keeps both error identities on the clean version.

knownIssues.rootCause: The retry path creates a new upload before checking whether the previous attempt completed.
knownIssues.failureBehavior: A lost response after a successful upload causes the retry to create duplicate remote objects.
knownIssues.verification: A focused test reproduces the duplicate upload only on this version.
